name: task-watch
description: Watches background commands and agents: a one-line status above the prompt every few minutes, written by a small model, and a wake-up for the main model when the work looks stuck or wrong

intervalMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
intervalMinutes.description: How often the background work is looked at and the status line rewritten

model.title: Watcher model
model.description: The model that writes the status line and judges the work: an alias such as haiku, or a full model id

stallMinutes.title: Silence that counts as stuck (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: A background command whose output has not changed for this long wakes the main model, whatever the watcher says

language.title: Status language
language.description: The language the status line is written in: auto follows the language of your own messages in the session, or name one, such as English

wake.title: Wake the main model
wake.description: Send the main model a message when the work looks stuck or wrong; off, the warning stays in the status line alone
